eligibility: All stations with a complete training window in the 17 Nov hourly release; complete 24h history and six target hours, own station, same Vrain channel, and complete historical ERA5 for the paired comparison. Predictors use only the past.

bilstm.selection: Lower pooled RMSE in physical mm across all six hours on 2023; same training budget and 13 input slots, ablated features fixed to standardized zero
bilstm.reported_prediction: Arithmetic mean of the three forecasts in mm

rain_lightgbm.predictors: Same Vrain history and month as R, flattened as 24 lags plus sum3/sum6/sum24/max6/max24; station id categorical

block_bootstrap.unit: paired local calendar-day blocks including all stations

replay.selection: Compare 2023 pooled all-lead RMSE for BiLSTM_R, LightGBM_R and persistence; use the lowest for Vrain-only replay
